title: Foreign keys survive whole-table sync and partial restore with interruption recovery
steps: Run the real MariaDB merge and cutover cases.
expect: Whole-table child and parent changes preserve two ordered foreign keys and reject invalid child writes.
Child-only, parent-only and combined restore rebind foreign keys to the live schema; pre-swap interruption and rollback restore the old graph.
Stored and virtual generated columns recompute correctly in whole-table and row merges.
Generated-only tables retain their row count without assigning computed values.

tests: whole-table sync preserves foreign keys and can replace a referenced parent
partial restore rebinds outgoing and untouched incoming foreign keys and rolls them back
generated columns recompute through whole-table and row merges
generated-only tables retain every row when taken whole
